mapper.select: SELECT cc.calendar_cell_id, cc.class_at , c.class_id, c.class_name, cd.class_detail_id, cd.student, cd.subject, cd.memo, cd.unit, cd.learned, cd.good_point, cd.issue, cd.comment FROM calendar_cells cc INNER JOIN classes c ON c.calendar_cell_id = cc.calendar_cell_id INNER JOIN class_details cd ON cd.class_id = c.class_id ORDER BY cc.class_at

SELECT cc.calendar_cell_id, cc.class_at , c.class_id, c.class_name, cd.class_detail_id, cd.student, cd.subject, cd.memo, cd.unit, cd.learned, cd.good_point, cd.issue, cd.comment FROM calendar_cells cc INNER JOIN classes c ON c.calendarCell = cc.calendar_cell_id INNER JOIN class_details cd ON cd.class_id = c.class_id WHERE cc.calendar_cell_id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE calendar_cells SET class_at = #{classAt} WHERE calendar_cell_id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.class_id, c.class_name, cd.class_detail_id, cd.student, cd.subject, cd.memo, cd.unit, cd.learned, cd.good_point, cd.issue, cd.comment FROM classes c INNER JOIN class_details cd ON cd.class_id = c.class_id WHERE c.class_id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE classes SET class_name VALUES (#{name}) WHERE class_id = #{id}

mapper.insert: INSERT class_details (class_id, student, class_subject, memo, teaching_unit, learned, good_point, issue, comment) VALUES (#{classId}, #{student}, #{subject}, #{memo}, #{unit}, #{learned}, #{goodPoint}, #{issue}, #{comment})
